assumptions.docuseal: Published $0.20 per completed submission, including multiple files/signers; Pro seat $20/month allocated in overhead.
assumptions.payments: 6.6% allocation of $1 signing usage under $10 recurring domestic-card funding; not a separate card charge.
assumptions.allocations: Hosting, email, support, acquisition and dispute figures are planning allowances, not measured bills.
assumptions.scope: One agreement with one counterparty and customer; no calls, SMS, enrichment or LLM invoked by signing itself.
assumptions.activation: Documentation-based quote authorized by owner. Invoices not required to configure. Available operating funds and live signing mode still required. Estimates never represent actual settled costs.
assumptions.fixedCostAllocation: Planning volume: 10,000 total billable operations/month, not a forecast. Baseline seats: Vercel $20, Railway Pro $20 minimum usage commitment, Supabase $25, Resend $20, DocuSeal $20. Existing allowances total $0.05/operation, or $500 at that volume. Below expected volume fixed costs can exceed recovery; company reserves must cover the gap. GitHub allowance is a reserve, not a claim of subscription price. No margin guarantee.
assumptions.margin: 5x estimated all-in cost target across each account, backed by settled operation revenue only. Outstanding costs reserve headroom; no cross-account subsidy.
